definitions.past_interval_target: d_hat_minus(k)=(v[k]-v[j])/(10*dt)-mean(a_f[j:k]), j=k-10, dt=0.001 s; uses only current/past velocity and internal filter acceleration.
definitions.historical_output: u_hist(j)=logged applied output at j; checked against beta[j]*clip(phi[j]^T W_before[j],-3,3).
definitions.current_weight_replay: u_rep(k<-j)=beta[j]*clip(phi[j]^T W_before[k],-3,3); W_before[k] is current pre-update weight, not W_after[k].
definitions.analytic_gradient: G_k=phi[j]*(beta[j]*m_k*e_k)^T; m_k[a]=1 if abs((phi[j]^T W_before[k])[a])<3, else 0. Exact +/-3 uses selected zero subgradient and is counted nondifferentiable.
definitions.actual_logged_weight_delta: DeltaW_k=W_after[k]-W_before[k], includes the runtime leakage and any elementwise projection; rebuilt from frozen runtime equation and compared geometrically to -G_k only.
definitions.beta_clock: Original ON1 beta at past event j is read from log and checked against min(transition_time[j]/1.8 s,1).
definitions.feature_normalization: Logged phi_33 is read directly and norm-checked to 1; no encoder re-execution or refit.
definitions.clip_counting: saturated iff abs(z)>3; exact kink iff abs(abs(z)-3)==0; near kink iff distance<=1e-12.

units_and_symbolic_normalization.symbolic_dimensionless_innovation: nu_k=Sigma_d^(-1/2)*e_k/beta_j, where Sigma_d has units (m/s^2)^2; Sigma_d is unknown and not estimated here.
units_and_symbolic_normalization.beta_squared_loss_scaling: Since e=beta*clip-target and G_raw already contains beta, for L_tilde=0.5*||e/beta_j||^2, G_tilde=G_raw/beta_j^2=phi*(m*e/beta_j)^T. At beta=0.18 the relative gradient multiplier is ~30.86; the explicit coefficient on e is 1/beta=~5.56. Scale note only; no alternative loss or gain was used.
units_and_symbolic_normalization.measurement_noise_bound: If per-axis velocity sensor noise is independent with SD sigma_v, differencing contributes sqrt(2)*sigma_v/0.01 m/s^2; sigma_v is unknown. Logged state velocity is not a noisy sensor record.

finite_difference.direction: fixed deterministic unit-Frobenius matrix sin(i*sqrt(2))+0.37*cos(i*sqrt(3)), i=1..99.

interpretation_limits: No weight update, training, optimizer, new gain, or closed-loop counterfactual was performed.
Gradient-to-original-update cosine/dot is local geometric evidence only, not an adaptive-law or closed-loop benefit result.
The delay target is a causal 10 ms finite-difference approximation; deployment noise floor is unknown.
The original update is tracking-error driven with beta, leakage and projection; it need not minimize this delayed prediction loss.
